objective: Ubiquitous Foundation of Global Agentic Commerce
completionRule: All workstreams require reviewed implementation and acceptance evidence. Simulation, local test doubles and StateSet-owned adapters do not establish live-provider or independent-adoption completion.

workstreams.title: Complete portable economic lifecycles
acceptance: Purchase, payment, fulfillment, return, refund, subscription and dispute commands share kernel authority and receipts
Every enabled mutation binds store, principal, budget and durable idempotency
Publish lifecycle coverage rather than inferring readiness from tool count

workstreams.title: Exact money across every boundary
acceptance: Audit binding, import, adapter, quote and receipt conversions
Define explicit asset identity, scale and rounding contracts
Run shared conformance vectors through actual supported runtimes and adapters

evidence.scope: CLI sandbox/shadow provider arithmetic and payment replay only
limitations: Legacy safe numeric inputs still accepted
Provider maps remain in memory
Real adapters and other language boundaries require separate verification

workstreams.title: Recoverable real transaction lifecycle
acceptance: Wire native orders, payment, fulfillment, partial refund and accounting reconciliation together
Kill workers at each external commit boundary and reconcile authoritative outcomes
Persist delivery jobs, retries, dead letters and recovery actions

findings.requirement: Enforce shipment transitions, optimistic concurrency, timestamps and durable outbox records consistently across update, ship, deliver, cancel and batch paths on SQLite and PostgreSQL
evidence: crates/stateset-db/src/shipment_updates.rs: shared transition, version and timestamp rules

findings.requirement: Expose validated intermediate shipment transitions in each public API before a platform-wide fulfillment release
evidence: crates/stateset-http/src/routes/shipments.rs: PATCH updates and separately authorized POST cancellation now use native lifecycle/version guards
cli/src/tools/shipments.js: update_shipment exposes intermediate stages; create passes required recipient data; convenience transitions accept expectedVersion
crates/stateset-http/tests/shipment_lifecycle.rs: 4 tests passed through bearer auth and authorization, including tenant isolation
Other language bindings and typed governed shipment commands remain to be completed

findings.requirement: Complete native shipment item support before claiming automatic partial-shipment compensation
evidence: cli/src/tools/fulfillment-recovery.js: read-only plans validate persisted order-line shipped quantities, aggregate requests and reject excess quantities, ambiguous SKUs and cross-order shipment references
cli/src/tools/shipments.js: unsupported automatic partial-shipment creation is removed; requests return an explicit blocked action with a reconciliation plan
bindings/node/src/domains/orders.rs and shipments.rs: rebuilt native binding exposes shippedQuantity, persisted shipment items and recipient context; native integration tests passed
Node shipment creation still lacks item assignment and parent linkage; shipment tracking and order fulfillment remain separate aggregates
SQLite and PostgreSQL item writes now lock the parent, enforce packing-state guards, advance versions, and commit item audit facts atomically; 25 backend lifecycle tests passed locally
remaining: Implement atomic follow-up shipment creation with authoritative order-line membership and quantity limits, recipient inheritance, parent linkage and durable request-bound idempotency
Reconcile already assigned shipment quantities with order fulfillment and inventory reservations under concurrency
Expose and verify typed governed recovery commands with restart, replay, concurrent-conflict and rollback tests

workstreams.title: Versioned protocol adapters and independent interoperability
acceptance: Map versioned UCP and AP2 capabilities to governed kernel commands
Complete ICP stateful flows, revocation, recovery and concurrent-conflict conformance
Run at least two independent out-of-tree implementations in their own CI

workstreams.title: Cross-organization delegation and spending controls
acceptance: Issue, attenuate, rotate and revoke scoped delegations
Bind store, tenant, counterparty, asset, amount, purpose and expiry
Share spending reservations across autonomous entrypoints
Revocation blocks new effects while preserving read-only reconciliation of signed or settled work

workstreams.title: Certified provider contracts and operator reconciliation
acceptance: Shopify update webhooks mutate native business records and preserve exact prices
Modernize supported Shopify public app integration to GraphQL
Certify actual provider effects, durable idempotency, webhook recovery and reconciliation
Replace simulated operator reconciliation with evidence from real records

workstreams.title: Runtime parity and economic-state portability

workstreams.title: Adoption, operating evidence and independent assurance
acceptance: Ship two independently configured agents with receipts, restart and exception recovery
Expose pending approvals, payments, deliveries and safe recovery to operators
Evaluate task success, refusal, injection, stale quotes, duplicates and interrupted settlement
Link reproducible CI, workload and recovery evidence to releases
Obtain independent security review and remediate findings
Keep kernel and contracts open; define managed operations, certified integration and support offerings

evidence.result: 11 passed; full-schema snapshot now captures 229 user tables instead of an empty array

findings.requirement: Make the full-schema snapshot test inspect actual user tables
evidence: Before correction, snapshot_migrations.rs used a wildcard exclusion that selected no tables
The regenerated snapshot now contains 229 user tables and the test requires the shipment table to be present
findings.resolution: Use literal GLOB exclusions, assert the shipment table is present, and regenerate the snapshot from 229 user tables.
